name: Steam Login
description: Allow users to sign in with their Steam account
author: uxwVend

api.description: Redirect the visitor to Steam to approve an OpenID sign-in.
Verify Steam's OpenID assertion and hand the browser a single-use sign-in ticket.
Report whether Steam login is configured, and the URLs Steam must be pointed at (admin).

steamAuth.title: Steam Login
steamAuth.signInFailed: Steam sign-in did not complete. The link may have expired.
steamAuth.adm_subtitle: Let visitors sign in with their Steam account.
steamAuth.adm_statusError: Could not read the Steam login status.
steamAuth.adm_notConfigured: Steam login is installed but inactive: the API key is not set.
steamAuth.adm_envVarHelp: Get a key at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, set this variable, and restart the app. Steam login uses an environment variable rather than a saved setting because sign-in providers are assembled at startup.
steamAuth.adm_returnToHelp: Steam sends people back here after they approve the sign-in. It is derived from AUTH_URL, so that variable has to match the address visitors actually use.
steamAuth.adm_realmHelp: The site name Steam shows on its approval screen. This is the domain you register the API key against.
steamAuth.adm_emailNote: Steam never shares an email address, so an account created this way gets a placeholder one that can never receive mail. Ask these users to set a real address in their profile.

steamAuth.title: Steam ile Giris
steamAuth.signInFailed: Steam girisi tamamlanmadi. Baglantinin suresi dolmus olabilir.
steamAuth.adm_subtitle: Ziyaretcilerin Steam hesabiyla giris yapmasina izin verin.
steamAuth.adm_notConfigured: Steam girisi kurulu ama pasif: API anahtari tanimli degil.
steamAuth.adm_envVarHelp: steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey adresinden bir anahtar alin, bu degiskeni tanimlayin ve uygulamayi yeniden baslatin. Giris saglayicilari uygulama acilirken kuruldugu icin Steam girisi kayitli ayar yerine ortam degiskeni kullanir.
steamAuth.adm_returnToHelp: Steam, girisi onaylayan kisiyi buraya geri gonderir. Adres AUTH_URL degiskeninden turetilir, bu yuzden o degiskenin ziyaretcilerin gercekten kullandigi adresle ayni olmasi gerekir.
steamAuth.adm_realmHelp: Steam'in onay ekraninda gosterdigi site adi. API anahtarini bu alan adina kaydedersiniz.
steamAuth.adm_emailNote: Steam hicbir zaman e-posta adresi paylasmaz, bu yuzden bu yolla acilan hesaba posta alamayan gecici bir adres atanir. Bu kullanicilardan profillerinde gercek bir adres tanimlamalarini isteyin.

steamAuth.title: Steam-Anmeldung
steamAuth.signInFailed: Die Steam-Anmeldung wurde nicht abgeschlossen. Der Link ist moglicherweise abgelaufen.
steamAuth.adm_subtitle: Besucher konnen sich mit ihrem Steam-Konto anmelden.
steamAuth.adm_statusError: Der Status der Steam-Anmeldung konnte nicht gelesen werden.
steamAuth.adm_notConfigured: Die Steam-Anmeldung ist installiert, aber inaktiv: Der API-Schlussel fehlt.
steamAuth.adm_envVarHelp: Holen Sie sich einen Schlussel unter steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, setzen Sie diese Variable und starten Sie die App neu. Die Steam-Anmeldung nutzt eine Umgebungsvariable statt einer gespeicherten Einstellung, weil Anmeldeanbieter beim Start zusammengestellt werden.
steamAuth.adm_returnToHelp: Steam schickt Nutzer nach der Bestatigung hierher zuruck. Die Adresse stammt aus AUTH_URL, diese Variable muss also der tatsachlich genutzten Adresse entsprechen.
steamAuth.adm_realmHelp: Der Seitenname, den Steam auf seinem Bestatigungsbildschirm zeigt. Auf diese Domain registrieren Sie den API-Schlussel.
steamAuth.adm_emailNote: Steam gibt niemals eine E-Mail-Adresse heraus. Ein so erstelltes Konto erhalt daher eine Platzhalteradresse, die keine Post empfangen kann. Bitten Sie diese Nutzer, im Profil eine echte Adresse zu hinterlegen.

steamAuth.title: Inicio de sesion con Steam
steamAuth.signInFailed: El inicio de sesion con Steam no se completo. Puede que el enlace haya caducado.
steamAuth.adm_subtitle: Permite que los visitantes inicien sesion con su cuenta de Steam.
steamAuth.adm_statusError: No se pudo leer el estado del inicio de sesion con Steam.
steamAuth.adm_configured: El inicio de sesion con Steam esta activo.
steamAuth.adm_notConfigured: El inicio de sesion con Steam esta instalado pero inactivo: falta la clave de API.
steamAuth.adm_envVarHelp: Consigue una clave en steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, define esta variable y reinicia la aplicacion. El inicio de sesion con Steam usa una variable de entorno en lugar de un ajuste guardado porque los proveedores de acceso se montan al arrancar.
steamAuth.adm_returnToHelp: Steam devuelve aqui a quien aprueba el acceso. La direccion sale de AUTH_URL, asi que esa variable debe coincidir con la que usan los visitantes.
steamAuth.adm_realmHelp: El nombre del sitio que Steam muestra en su pantalla de aprobacion. Es el dominio con el que registras la clave de API.
steamAuth.adm_emailNote: Steam nunca comparte una direccion de correo, asi que una cuenta creada por esta via recibe una direccion provisional que no puede recibir mensajes. Pide a estos usuarios que definan una real en su perfil.

steamAuth.title: Connexion Steam
steamAuth.signInFailed: La connexion Steam n'a pas abouti. Le lien a peut-etre expire.
steamAuth.adm_subtitle: Permettre aux visiteurs de se connecter avec leur compte Steam.
steamAuth.adm_statusError: Impossible de lire l'etat de la connexion Steam.
steamAuth.adm_notConfigured: La connexion Steam est installee mais inactive : la cle d'API n'est pas definie.
steamAuth.adm_envVarHelp: Obtenez une cle sur steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, definissez cette variable puis redemarrez l'application. La connexion Steam passe par une variable d'environnement plutot qu'un reglage enregistre, car les fournisseurs de connexion sont assembles au demarrage.
steamAuth.adm_returnToHelp: Steam y renvoie les personnes apres validation. L'adresse vient de AUTH_URL, cette variable doit donc correspondre a celle qu'utilisent reellement les visiteurs.
steamAuth.adm_realmHelp: Le nom de site que Steam affiche sur son ecran de validation. C'est le domaine sur lequel vous enregistrez la cle d'API.
steamAuth.adm_emailNote: Steam ne communique jamais d'adresse e-mail : un compte cree ainsi recoit une adresse fictive qui ne peut rien recevoir. Demandez a ces utilisateurs d'en definir une vraie dans leur profil.

steamAuth.title: Vhod cherez Steam
steamAuth.signInFailed: Vhod cherez Steam ne zavershilsya. Vozmozhno, ssylka ustarela.
steamAuth.adm_subtitle: Razreshite posetitelyam vhodit s akkauntom Steam.
steamAuth.adm_statusError: Ne udalos prochitat sostoyanie vhoda cherez Steam.
steamAuth.adm_notConfigured: Vhod cherez Steam ustanovlen, no neaktiven: ne zadan klyuch API.
steamAuth.adm_envVarHelp: Poluchite klyuch na steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, zadayte etu peremennuyu i perezapustite prilozhenie. Vhod cherez Steam ispolzuet peremennuyu okruzheniya, a ne sohranennuyu nastroyku, potomu chto provaydery vhoda sobirayutsya pri zapuske.
steamAuth.adm_returnToHelp: Syuda Steam vozvrashchaet polzovatelya posle podtverzhdeniya. Adres beretsya iz AUTH_URL, poetomu eta peremennaya dolzhna sovpadat s adresom, kotorym polzuyutsya posetiteli.
steamAuth.adm_realmHelp: Imya sayta, kotoroe Steam pokazyvaet na ekrane podtverzhdeniya. Na etot domen vy registriruete klyuch API.
steamAuth.adm_emailNote: Steam nikogda ne peredaet adres pochty, poetomu sozdannyy tak akkaunt poluchaet vremennyy adres, na kotoryy nichego nelzya otpravit. Poprosite takih polzovateley ukazat nastoyashchiy adres v profile.

steamAuth.title: Login com Steam
steamAuth.signInFailed: O login com a Steam nao foi concluido. A ligacao pode ter expirado.
steamAuth.adm_subtitle: Permita que os visitantes entrem com a conta Steam.
steamAuth.adm_statusError: Nao foi possivel ler o estado do login com a Steam.
steamAuth.adm_configured: O login com a Steam esta ativo.
steamAuth.adm_notConfigured: O login com a Steam esta instalado mas inativo: falta a chave de API.
steamAuth.adm_envVarHelp: Obtenha uma chave em steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, defina esta variavel e reinicie a aplicacao. O login com a Steam usa uma variavel de ambiente em vez de uma definicao guardada porque os fornecedores de login sao montados no arranque.
steamAuth.adm_returnToHelp: A Steam devolve aqui quem aprova o acesso. O endereco vem de AUTH_URL, por isso essa variavel tem de corresponder ao endereco que os visitantes usam.
steamAuth.adm_realmHelp: O nome do site que a Steam mostra no ecra de aprovacao. E o dominio com que regista a chave de API.
steamAuth.adm_emailNote: A Steam nunca partilha um endereco de email, por isso uma conta criada assim recebe um endereco provisorio que nao consegue receber mensagens. Peca a estes utilizadores que definam um real no perfil.
